title: Choose a hosted entity contract
responsibility: Prefer the plan contract, otherwise hash the registered unit contract.

inputs.name: hubEntityContract.unit
inputs.description: The unit's ComponentManifest `contract`, which is hashed with hubContractHash only when `plan` is falsy; a truthy `plan` takes precedence and leaves it unused. The code does not validate it: a missing `contract` yields the SHA-256 of empty input, while a BigInt or circular value makes the call reject.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: File name checked against letters, digits, dot, underscore and hyphen, starting with a letter or digit, at most 200 characters, with no '..' sequence.

outputs.name: hubFile
outputs.description: The same file name, returned unchanged.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown with code invalid-path when the name fails the pattern or contains '..'.

inputs.name: bytes
inputs.description: Committed artifact bytes, decoded as strict UTF-8 before parsing.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown with code artifact-corrupt when the bytes are not strict UTF-8 JSON.

inputs.name: hubEntityContract.plan
inputs.description: The plan's `contract`, returned unchanged whenever `plan` is truthy, so it takes precedence over `unit`. The code neither computes nor checks its `hash`; the EntityContract type documents that field as the SHA-256 of the contract an approval binds, or null when the entity has no contract yet.

inputs.name: rows
inputs.description: Evidence rows, drawn in the order given.

outputs.name: hubEntityContract
outputs.description: The value the function resolves to: `plan.contract` unchanged when `plan` is truthy, otherwise the unit's `contract` spread with a `hash` field, or `{ inputs: [], outputs: [], errors: [], hash: null }` when both `plan` and `unit` are absent. The added `hash` is a 64-character lowercase hex SHA-256 of the unit contract serialized by canonicalJson, which sorts object keys at every depth and drops undefined fields.

inputs.description: File name checked against letters, digits, dot, underscore and hyphen, starting with a letter or digit, at most 200 characters, with no '..' sequence.

outputs.name: hubFile
outputs.description: The same file name, returned unchanged.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown with code invalid-path when the name fails the pattern or contains '..'.

inputs.name: rows
inputs.description: Evidence rows, drawn in the order given.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown by JSON.stringify inside canonicalJson when `unit.contract` contains a BigInt, a value the ComponentManifest type does not allow; hubEntityContract rejects with it.

errors.name: RangeError
errors.description: Thrown when `unit.contract` contains a circular reference, which the ComponentManifest type does not allow, because the recursion in canonicalJson's `sorted` never ends and exhausts the call stack; hubEntityContract rejects with it.
